#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
exec >>/home/phat/ml-experiments/cbc4cc95c5f6/fault.log 2>&1
test "$(hostname -s)" = srv01
ip -j -4 address show dev enp0s8 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; assert any(a.get("local")=="192.168.56.20" for link in json.load(sys.stdin) for a in link.get("addr_info",[]))'

echo FAULT_BEFORE $(date -u +%s)

nft add table inet mlv2_cbc4cc95c5f6
nft 'add chain inet mlv2_cbc4cc95c5f6 input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy accept; }'
nft add rule inet mlv2_cbc4cc95c5f6 input ip saddr 192.168.56.10 tcp dport 80 counter drop
nft list table inet mlv2_cbc4cc95c5f6
echo FAULT_VERIFIED $(date -u +%s)
